data.name: Husool
data.gender_notes: Husool is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'h-s-l', meaning to give or distribute generously. In Islamic tradition, Husool is a name given to a boy symbolizing kindness and generosity. The name Husool carries the meaning “Generous, Kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Husool usually hope their child will grow to embody generous, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Husool belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Generous, Kind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Husool total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
